scenes.title: Buddha head
scenes.caption: Cameras and point cloud predicted by VGGT-Ω from 34 photos, accelerated with RAWATTA (--config rawatta). Forward pass 900.8 ms on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER (median of 10 timed runs). Photos: Buddha Dataset by Simone Gasparini, Fabien Castan and Yann Lanthony (AliceVision), doi:10.5281/zenodo.1203283, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); 34 of 67 photos, downscaled.
